bayts.text: My Lord surprised me with what minds crave, by the standing of the most excellent of those who took refuge in Allah.
My praise to a Generous Lord Who has no partner; and my breast today He has filled with radiant light.
Muḥammad — the blessings of Allah forever upon him, in his party —: through him (Allah) has kept all of me.
I call upon my God, Whose gifts have encompassed all creation, (giving) what He chooses, He Who created.
I conversed with Him intimately — exalted be He — for years, and He honoured me with the honouring of a Guide, and all of me has become free of idle talk.
O All-Merciful, grant all creation the mercy of Him Who frees from evil whoever recites His Qurʾān.
Keep the community of the Chosen from every corruption, and have mercy on creation, O You Who began their ancestor (Adam).
O Owner of dominion, O You exalted above retaliation, have mercy on all creation, O Guide Who supports.
You effaced the harm that had made for the heart, by the standing of the most excellent of those who took refuge in Allah.
